context: A uni student helps a teen friend prep for exam week
purpose: Teach: いたる/現われ/手助け/めざし/暖房/目前/５つ/反動

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、試験を目前にしてもう心が折れそうです…
lines.en: Senpai, with exams right around the corner, I'm about to lose it...
lines.style: Anxious teen voice, slightly trembling and pleading.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 落ち着け。合格をめざし努力してきたんだろ？
lines.en: Calm down. You've been working hard aiming to pass, right?
lines.style: Warm older-brother tone, steady and reassuring delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも徹夜の反動で昼間ぼーっとして、勉強の手助けが欲しいです。
lines.en: But the rebound from all-nighters leaves me dazed, I want help studying.
lines.style: Whiny exhausted teen, dragging the vowels slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ部屋の暖房つけて、まず弱点を５つ書き出してみろ。
lines.en: Then turn on the heater, and first write out five of your weak points.
lines.style: Practical mentor tone, brisk and instructive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 数学だけは、いくら頑張っても成果が現われなくて…
lines.en: It's just math — no matter how hard I try, no results show up...
lines.style: Defeated teen, voice trailing off into a sigh.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今夜遅くにいたるまで付き合ってやるから、安心しろよ。
lines.en: I'll stick with you until late tonight, so don't worry, okay.
lines.style: Generous senpai tone, firm and quietly affectionate throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当ですか？涙が出そうです、先輩は救世主みたい…
lines.en: Really? I might cry — senpai, you're like a savior...
lines.style: Overdramatic teen relief, half-laughing half-emotional, distinct timbre that anchors the scene

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大げさだな。これで効果が現われたら、ジュース一本おごれよ。
lines.en: Don't exaggerate. If this works, you owe me one juice.
lines.style: Teasing chuckle, light and casual closer.
